query: Will my CPF Investment Scheme (CPFIS) investments be sold or liquidated when I apply to withdraw my CPFIS investments upon meeting CPF withdrawal conditions?
reference_answer: Applying to withdraw your CPFIS investments will not result in liquidation of your investment holdings. If your withdrawal application is approved, your agent bank and/or product providers will contact you on the transfer of your investments to you.

answer: No, your CPFIS investments will not be sold or liquidated when you apply to withdraw them. [Document 2] states that applying to withdraw your CPFIS investments will not result in the liquidation of your investment holdings. [Document 1] explains that the maturity proceeds are refunded to your CPF account, allowing you to transfer them back.
